notes: Added missing coverage for ingestion hooks, integration with existing logging/safety systems, and test validation for append-only guarantees.

GOV-F-004-S30.title: Audit Logging Ingestion Hooks (GPT/Claude Operations)
GOV-F-004-S30.description: Instrument core system entry points (tool_router, safety_service, GPT/Claude orchestration loop, GPT Reader) to emit audit events conforming to schema. Ensure all model decisions, tool invocations, and safety triggers are captured.

GOV-F-004-S31.title: Integration with Existing Debug Logger
GOV-F-004-S31.description: Integrate append-only audit logging with existing debug_logger to avoid duplication while ensuring audit logs remain independent and immutable. Route critical events (errors, token usage, metadata) into audit pipeline with hash chaining.

GOV-F-004-S32.title: Append-Only Enforcement and Tamper Detection Tests
GOV-F-004-S32.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating that audit records cannot be updated or deleted, and that hash-chain integrity detects tampering or gaps. Include negative tests simulating mutation attempts.

GOV-F-004-S33.title: Cross-System Audit Consistency Integration
GOV-F-004-S33.description: Ensure consistent audit logging across Chat backend, Data Pipelines, and Brain operations by standardizing event structure and verifying propagation across systems. Validate compatibility with Brain runner and SIT logging.
